surfaces.mechanism_doc: GET /api/v1/app-conversations/search (limit, page_id, include_sub_conversations, filters); GET /api/v1/app-conversations?ids=...; records: id, created_by_user_id, selected_repository/branch, trigger, parent/sub conversation ids, status, timestamps, tags, accumulated token and cost metrics, session_api_key (a secret)
surfaces.notes: Pure driver internal/vendorapi/openhands AppConversations (lane CA-A4, cloud agents arc): one openhands.app_conversation snapshot per conversation plus one usage row (tokens and accumulated cost in USD, revision updated_at) where metrics are reported. The driver is closed-DTO and never decodes session_api_key (returns_secret). include_sub_conversations=true is always sent (the default omits child conversations). Conformance against the vendormock mock through the pure adapter. Consumed by the node cloud-agents connector (lane CA-B2), not by the org runner. Synthetic only; member names and the updated_at window filter names are Inferred from the reference (sources OH01, OH04).

surfaces.mechanism_doc: GET /api/v1/conversation/{conversation_id}/events/search (kind, timestamp bounds, sort_order, page_id, limit at most 100); GET .../events/count; GET .../download (ZIP of events and metadata). Events: message, action, observation, LLM completion logs, token events, hook execution, deltas, errors
surfaces.notes: Pure driver internal/vendorapi/openhands Events (lane CA-A4, cloud agents arc): a MessageEvent lands as a content item (user prompt, agent response); every other event kind lands as a metadata-only event row (tool call, tool result, error, state change; the tool name and call id, never arguments or output); an undocumented kind lands as other and trips the canary. Closed-DTO: action and observation bodies are never decoded (may_return_secret). Conformance against the vendormock mock through the pure adapter. Consumed by the node connector (lane CA-B2), not by the org runner. Synthetic only; member names, the event kind names and the timestamp filter names are Inferred from the reference (source OH08).
